method: Independent parsing of the original cached ZIP central directory and original classic NetCDF bytes, without using prepare_air.py or rendered manifest for source extraction. Six small sibling members retrieved by HTTP range and independently CRC-verified; all 99 original cached 0.5-degree members and one previously downloaded -2-degree sibling also verified. Rendered manifest used only for a final midpoint comparison.

centralDirectory.zipTimeMeaning: 2018 ZIP filesystem timestamps are file creation/conversion-era metadata, not 2013 radar observation times; timezone not specified.

conclusions.filenameVMeans: Native volume_number; v1..v99 in consecutive groups
conclusions.filenameSMeans: Elevation-file index, not a later acquisition time. Native sweep_number matches filename sN, despite its misleading 0_based long_name.
conclusions.selectedS6: Actual fixed angle is 0.5 degrees in every one of the 99 source files.
conclusions.absoluteClockValidation: Not established: repeated time strings are internally consistent, but may all originate from the same unverified acquisition or conversion clock. No independent event anchor or justified clock offset was found in these files.
conclusions.mergingImplication: Combining same-timestamp elevation files is consistent with one multi-elevation volume. It does not create extra temporal information or fix zero ray times.
conclusions.precisionLimit: The displayed midpoint is representative of the global acquisition interval. It is not a recovered per-ray timestamp, and interval duration is not a bound on absolute clock error.

fullVolumePipelineChecks.method: Additional conversion-time verification of every original member, separate from the106-file independent metadata audit above.
